subject: Principles of Drug Elimination and Organ Clearance
topic: Clearance Kinetics: Mathematical Identity vs. Physiological Extraction
syllabus_context: Pharmacokinetics Unit 3: Clearance and Elimination. Rate of elimination, elimination rate constant k_e, apparent volume of distribution V_d, organ clearance model CL = Q * E, renal glomerular filtration and transporter mechanisms.
declared_learning_objective: Derive the mathematical relationship between clearance, volume of distribution, and elimination rate constant; differentiate mathematical elimination models from physiological organ extraction mechanisms; explain organ clearance in terms of blood flow and extraction ratio; and evaluate the biological processes of renal filtration, active secretion, and reabsorption.

recording_quality.known_observability_limitations: Pharmacokinetic formulas and organ vascular schematics discussed verbally and sketched on board.
